description: This file contains C++ source code for the Metadata class, which serializes key-value metadata into a parcel for Android media framework, including methods for appending data types and checking keys.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing metadata key-value pairs into a parcel.

methods.name: appendBool
methods.description: Serializes a boolean value with a key into the parcel.

methods.name: appendInt32
methods.description: Serializes an integer value with a key into the parcel.

methods.name: resetParcel
methods.description: Resets the parcel's data position to the beginning of the metadata.

methods.name: updateLength
methods.description: Updates the length field at the start of the parcel with the current data size.

methods.name: checkKey
methods.description: Validates the key and checks for duplicates within the parcel.
